summary: postinstall exfiltrates AWS ECS task metadata to attacker-controlled ngrok tunnel
details: Package tarball contains only a package.json (no source, README, main, or bin) whose sole effect is a postinstall lifecycle hook. On `npm install`, the hook fetches the AWS ECS container task metadata endpoint (ECS_CONTAINER_METADATA_URI_V4 + '/task') and POSTs the JSON response — including container names and CloudWatch log group/stream identifiers — via `curl -X POST` to the hardcoded destination https://mourner-slot-explicit.ngrok-free.dev. The ngrok-free.dev host is an attacker-controlled tunnel unrelated to any legitimate publisher. The package has no advertised functionality; its only behavior on install is this data-collection callback, matching a dependency-confusion / namespace-squat recon payload targeting AWS ECS build and runtime environments.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
